meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude在执行计算密集任务前会先运行脚本检测主机资源，生成一个 .claude_resources.json 文件，记录 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘信息，并据此给出并行、内存、GPU 加速等策略建议。
howto.when: 当用户提出资源感知规划需求，或在明显吃资源的本地任务开始前（如大文件分析、模型训练、并行处理）触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个50GB的基因组数据集
say.note: Claude会先检测资源，再决定用不用Dask/Zarr。

say.text: 我要在本机训练神经网络，先检测一下有没有可用的GPU。
say.note: 识别三种平台的GPU后端并推荐库。

say.text: 我要并行处理10000个文件，该用几个worker？
say.note: 根据CPU核心数给出并行策略和建议的worker数。

howto.what_en: Before compute-intensive tasks, Claude runs the detection script, saves .claude_resources.json with CPU/GPU/memory/disk info, and gives strategy recommendations for parallelism, memory, GPU acceleration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for resource-aware planning, or before clearly resource-intensive local tasks such as large-file analysis, model training, or parallel processing.

say_en.text: Help me analyze this 50GB genomics dataset.
say_en.note: Claude checks resources, then decides on Dask/Zarr.

say_en.text: I want to train a neural network locally; check GPU availability.
say_en.note: Detects NVIDIA/AMD/Apple backends and suggests libraries.

say_en.text: I need to process 10,000 files in parallel; how many workers?
say_en.note: Recommends parallelism strategy and worker count.
